name: Accenture Strategy
one_liner: Strategy practice of Accenture, the world's largest professional services firm, known for tying strategy to technology-led execution.
at_a_glance: Parent Accenture has roughly 779,000 people and ~$70B revenue (FY2025).
Strategy practice focuses on business, technology, and functional strategy.
Positions itself as taking strategies 'from idea through execution.'

rounds: Process varies by role and office; typically ~2 rounds of interviews by video or in person.
Interviews usually blend behavioral questions with a case or business discussion.
interview_process.case_style: Varies; may be a traditional case or a short business prompt you analyze briefly, then present and discuss. Practicality and creativity both matter.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions on client impact, teamwork, and interest in technology-enabled change.
interview_process.assessments: Some Accenture roles use online skills assessments; not standard for MBA strategy roles per public sources.

culture: Scale and technology depth define the experience.
Execution-focused: strategy teams often stay through implementation.
why_us_angles: How does Accenture's strategy-to-execution model fit your product-building background?
Which technology or AI transformation themes do you want to work on?
Why does scale and implementation access matter to you?
prep_tips: Practice both traditional cases and short prompt-and-present formats.
Prepare to discuss technology and AI trends credibly.
Clarify the exact team and interview format with your recruiter.
